# Configuration reference

The config file is YAML. `lambe init` writes it to the user config directory
(`~/Library/Application Support/lambe/config.yaml` on macOS, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lambe/config.yaml`
or `~/.config/lambe/config.yaml` on Linux); `--config FILE` or `LAMBE_CONFIG` selects another.

Precedence, lowest to highest: built-in defaults, the config file, then environment
variables. There are no per-key command-line flags. Unknown keys in the file and values
of the wrong type are errors, with a suggestion when a key looks misspelled.

An environment variable is `LAMBE_` plus the key in upper case, with the first `.`
replaced by `_` and any further separator also `_` (`supervisor.tick_seconds` is
`LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_TICK_SECONDS`). List keys and top-level keys containing an underscore
can only be set in the file.

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `harness` | string | pi | `LAMBE_HARNESS` | Agent backend: `pi`, `codex`, or `acp`. |
| `machine` | string | hostname's first label | `LAMBE_MACHINE` | Dispatch affinity name for this host (`lambe/machine:<name>` labels). Must be distinct per host sharing a tracker. |
| `actor` | string | `lambe@<machine>` | `LAMBE_ACTOR` | Tracker identity stamped on claims and heartbeats. Every host sharing one tracker needs a distinct actor; `lambe doctor` prints the resolved value. |
| `workflow_path` | string | first existing `WORKFLOW.md` candidate | file only | Explicit location of the default `WORKFLOW.md`. Relative paths are not resolved against the config file. |
| `workspace.root` | string | under the state directory | `LAMBE_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Directory for per-issue workspaces. A relative path is resolved against the config file's directory. |
| `labels` | list | unset | file only | Opt-in work lane: claim only issues carrying every listed label. Cannot be combined with `workflows`. |
| `trackers` | list | one repo tracker `local` at `.` | file only | Beads sources lambe may use; each item has `name`, `type` (`hub` or `repo`) and `path`. Only the first is supervised. |
| `workflows` | list | unset | file only | Named workflows; each item has `name`, `label`, `path`, and optional `gate_dir` and `harness`. See Named workflows in REFERENCE.md. |
| `acp.agent` | string | opencode | `LAMBE_ACP_AGENT` | Known ACP agent to run when `harness: acp`. |
| `acp.command` | list | unset | file only | Explicit argv for the ACP agent; takes precedence over `acp.agent`. A relative executable path is resolved against the config file's directory. |
| `gate.check_timeout` | duration | `silence_timeout / 2`, minimum 1m | `LAMBE_GATE_CHECK_TIMEOUT` | Bound on each external gate check (a test run, a CI poll), independent of the silence timeout. Raise it for slow suites. |
| `stateapi.enable` | boolean | false | `LAMBE_STATEAPI_ENABLE` | Serve the bearer-guarded read-only state API on loopback. Off means no listener exists. |
| `stateapi.addr` | string | 127.0.0.1:0 | `LAMBE_STATEAPI_ADDR` | Loopback `host:port` to bind; port 0 picks an ephemeral port. Non-loopback addresses are rejected. |
| `supervisor.tick_seconds` | integer | 10 | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_TICK_SECONDS` | Supervisor loop cadence in seconds. |
| `supervisor.attempt_cap` | integer | 8 | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_ATTEMPT_CAP` | Most attempts per work item before it becomes needs-human. Must be at least 1. |
| `supervisor.silence_timeout` | duration | 10m | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_SILENCE_TIMEOUT` | No agent output for this long: the watchdog probes, then kills the run. |
| `supervisor.turn_timeout` | duration | 1h | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_TURN_TIMEOUT` | Hard cap on one agent turn. |
| `supervisor.heartbeat_interval` | duration | 150s | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | How often the claim lease is extended in the tracker. |
| `supervisor.heartbeat_ttl_second` | integer | 450 | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_HEARTBEAT_TTL_SECOND` | Assumed lease TTL in seconds; the heartbeat interval must stay well below it. |
| `supervisor.stall_after` | duration | 5m | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_STALL_AFTER` | The single stall threshold: a running run with no activity this long is `stalled` in the state API, TUI and `lambe doctor`. Observation only; the watchdog acts at `silence_timeout`. |
| `supervisor.probe_window` | duration | driver default (30s) | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_PROBE_WINDOW` | Pi harness only: how long the watchdog waits for any response after its steer probe before killing. |
| `supervisor.auto_reclaim` | boolean | false | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_AUTO_RECLAIM` | Run `bd reclaim` every tick, reverting `in_progress` issues whose lease expired more than `reclaim_grace` ago. For shared Dolt-server deployments only; see MULTI-MACHINE.md. |
| `supervisor.reclaim_grace` | duration | 10m | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_RECLAIM_GRACE` | Grace period before an expired lease is reclaimed. Only used with `auto_reclaim`; must exceed the tick interval. |
| `supervisor.orphan_claim_ttl` | duration | 1h | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_ORPHAN_CLAIM_TTL` | How long a recovered claim with no continuation state may stay blocked before the daemon stops heartbeating it so its lease can expire. `0` heartbeats forever. The claim is never released automatically. |
| `supervisor.bd_timeout` | duration | 60s | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_BD_TIMEOUT` | Bound on one `bd` read or heartbeat run; the clock starts when the process starts, not while it queues. Raise it on a slow embedded hub. |
| `supervisor.bd_write_timeout` | duration | 0s (= `bd_timeout`) | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_BD_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | Bound on one `bd` write (claim, attempt record, close). |
| `supervisor.bd_max_concurrency` | integer | 3 | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_BD_MAX_CONCURRENCY` | Most `bd` subprocesses running at once. Writes jump the queue ahead of reads, and reads ahead of heartbeats. |
| `supervisor.bd_queue_wait` | duration | 10m | `LAMBE_SUPERVISOR_BD_QUEUE_WAIT` | How long a `bd` call may wait for a free slot before it fails. |
